description: Machine-readable app registry for the Ruflo workspace. Single source of truth for docs, tooling, and lifecycle. Update when adding, retiring, or moving any entry under packages/, vendor/, or standalone roots. On 2026-08-21 every app under apps/ was migrated to its own standalone GitHub repo and is listed under 'external'.

lifecycleStates.active: Shipped product; has CI and an owner.
lifecycleStates.incubating: In development behind a branch or feature flag; not yet listed as active.
lifecycleStates.maintenance: Shipped but not under active feature work; security/bug fixes only.
lifecycleStates.archived: Frozen reference; not developed further (e.g. scraped build kept for provenance).
lifecycleStates.superseded: Replaced by another entry; kept only to document the migration.
lifecycleStates.tooling: Internal skill/helper/daemon — not a user-facing app but part of delivery.
lifecycleStates.external: Standalone repo outside this workspace; referenced for ecosystem completeness.

siteConvention: Each active app's marketing landing lives in a sibling folder inside the same repo (<app>-site). Sites inherit lifecycle from their app unless overridden. Each site deploys as its own Vercel project, so cross-site links must be absolute: siteUrl is the source of truth and every site page carries it as rel=canonical.
